summary: Sawyer County, WI tower listed as standing; a September 1936 entry describes a truck trail to its new location; build date, builder and owner not found.

events.note: In September 1936 a crew from the Winter Side Camp started a new truck trail to the tower's new location; the entry does not say whether the tower itself was moved

evidence.supports: tower is in Sawyer County, Wisconsin
September 1936: new truck trail to the new location of the tower started by a crew from the Winter Side Camp
evidence.quote: The project of construction of the new truck trail to the new location of the pipestone tower is started by a crew from the Winter Side Camp

evidence.supports: the entry credits The Voice of 1610, tied to CCC Camp Connors Lake
evidence.quote: The Voice of 1610 - CCC Camp Connors Lake

evidence.supports: listed as a standing tower in Sawyer County

corrections.why: The field holds a dated quotation from the Forest Lookouts page, not an agency name. The page gives no agency.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources were usable. No Wisconsin Historical Society record or NRHP listing was found for Pipestone. A Wisconsin Historical Society social post and a search snippet describe a 1935 CCC move of a tower, but the sources tie that move to the Mountain tower in Oconto County, so it is not used here. The social post could not be fetched (login wall). Height, design, build year, builder, owner and access are unknown. The brief's elevation_m of 499 comes from OSM and was not checked here.
